name: judgment-outcome
description: Judgment outcomes and seats (MUSA backlog S1): per-card outcome records (adopted decision / actual result / match-mismatch / recorder / time), the 14-day "結果は?" follow-up through the dedicated Genius channel, per-seat match-rate stats, and AI-proposed / human-confirmed seat tags for the 9 judgment seats.
cardTemplate: Summarise the "judgment-outcome" domain: per-card outcome records, the 14-day follow-up through the Genius channel, per-seat match rates and human-confirmed seat tags.

rationale: Outcome, follow-up, stats and seats are one feature: the seat tag exists to slice the outcome match rate, and the follow-up exists to fill outcomes. Kept apart from card-feedback (retrieval quality) on purpose.
